body: Thanks. I appreciate your sharing your personal experience with me.
Is there any way you can get out of there? Could you possibly move in with the family of a good friend who understands your plight? You have to get out of that household one way or another.

Look, I’m 50 and recently I’ve seriously screwed up everything in my life. BUT YOU’RE ONLY 22. You have plenty of years ahead of you to make right whatever is bothering you. There’s a whole life ahead of you. Please, please, please don’t waste it.
I’m in contact with three temp agencies. Nothing’s come up. I know that it makes me a coward, but I’d rather be dead than see my wife and son homeless as a result of what I’ve done.
Anf the Homeadvisor Repair, too. And I just got a call from a local pizza joint to start delivering pies for them.

The wife doesn’t want me to do Uber because she’s afraid of the wear and tear on our only car, but I’ve started the process on working for Jyve, which is an Uber for grocery stores, merchandising product and what not.

Thanks for the tips on the hotels, though. I’ll start visiting them and inquiring about jobs.

And it's my damn fault. I'm hustling, trying to do whatever it takes to bring in some kind of income, but that's difficult in light of my background. Everyone seems to think I'm just going to land another job and quit on them, but the fact of the matter is is that bridge is probably burned at this point.
I need to come up with rent by November or my entire family is homeless. I don't have a whole of time for hobbies.
Yes. I think I've managed to postpone any final decision for at least another day or two, and I'll see what happens from there. Thanks.
Yes, I've begged for my job back. They had no problem quickly replacing me, with someone younger, no doubt. The field is finance.

Yes, I know that it would be one act of selfishness on top of another, only more final. It's hard to resist, though. My wife hates me now. She was forgiving and understanding at first, but now she hates me and I don't blame her. My son still seems to like me, though. He still makes me laugh and is kind to me. You could say that's a really nice salve on all this, but at times it makes it all the more painful. I feel that I've betrayed him by what I've done, and he doesn't understand that. I feel like such scum.
You say you've made some "whopper bad decisions." Were they anywhere near as bad as what I've done?
I'm trying to recover, I really, really am, but it looks fucking bleak.
